messages:
Lena: Quick question about /v1/generate output shapes — when an optional string field is 'empty', should we return null, an empty string (\"\"), or drop the key? Clients are parsing inconsistently.
Michael: Short take: prefer omitting optional primitive fields. For optional objects that carry subfields, prefer explicit null so shape is detectable.
Rahul: +1 on omit for primitives. One caveat: some older mobile SDKs expect \"\" for `summary`. We need a compatibility plan.
Lena: Can we detect client version and serve compatibility? e.g., header-based routing? @Michael any telemetry on which client versions choke on omit vs empty?
Michael: We can route by `X-Client-Version`. Plan: default new behavior (omit primitives), but if header < 2.0, return legacy shape with `summary: \"\"`.
Rahul: That seems better than adding ad-hoc runtime flags. We already use header routing for a few beta features.
Lena: What about Accept/Content-Type behavior? Some proxies strip Accept headers.
Michael: Always set `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` on JSON responses. Streaming endpoints keep `application/x-ndjson`.
Rahul: Also: for `structured_output` (object) prefer explicit null when no data. That helps clients distinguish \"no object\" vs \"empty object\".
Lena: So: agreed defaults — primitives omitted when empty, objects set to null, Content-Type always present, and `X-Client-Version` header to route legacy clients.
Michael: I'll add a runtime canary: two rings, legacy shape for old header, new shape otherwise. Will emit telemetry events: `response.shape=omit_primitive` and `response.shape=empty_string` so we can compare errors.
Rahul: Add CI contract tests covering: primitive absent, primitive empty string, object null, object absent. Also update SDK unwrap tests.
Lena: Please open the RFC/PR with examples and a migration section for SDKs. I need that for release notes.
Michael: Will open PR shortly with example payloads and a short migration guide. Linking PR here when ready.
devx-bot: api-lint: schema-check failed on branch feature/response-shape — missing example for `summary` absent-case. (CI link)
Michael: Pushing fix in ~10m. If no objections we'll canary tomorrow and watch telemetry for 48h before widening rollout. :thumbsup:
Lena: Sounds good, thanks!
Rahul: Thanks — pinging docs to update API reference.
Monica (docs): Got it, I'll update reference and add a migration note for older SDKs.
